doc: ratatoskr graph revert (Urdr Task 17; storage §6.6): a title changed in one tx is put back by `graph revert --tx N` from the command line, as a new version the user's tx writes; --cascade only lists; a revert with no target or both is a usage error.

args: mkdir -p $ROOT/work/alpha && cd $ROOT/work/alpha && export GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='@1700000000 +0000' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='@1700000000 +0000' && git -c init.defaultBranch=main init -q && git -c user.name=t -c user.email=t@example.invalid -c commit.gpgsign=false commit -q --allow-empty -m alpha

params.sql: select updated_tx from entity where id = ?1

sql: select title, ver from entity where id = '$task'
select title, ver from entity where id = '$task'
select t.actor, t.class from entity e join tx t on t.id = e.updated_tx where e.id = '$task'
